text:
The core regulates poorly: line_reg is 0.76 V/V and PSRR is 8 dB. The NMOS-follower β-loop has weak loop gain, around 0.7, so any Vds or Early error moves the PTAT current. I'm switching to a Banba reference whose branch voltages are equalized by a single-stage, self-biased NMOS-input OTA. That gives high loop gain, and the dominant pole at pb is PSRR-friendly. The vref-gated start-up is kept.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Follower core lacks loop gain (line 0.76 V/V, PSRR 8 dB, TC off). Replace with OTA-regulated Banba: NMOS-input OTA drives PMOS mirror gate pb directly, dominant pole cap vdd-pb, self-biased tail, gated start-up. Scaled R3 output."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Ie":     (0.15e-6, 0.06e-6, 0.4e-6),  # PTAT emitter current per core branch
    "r0k":    (11.5, 7.0, 18.0),           # R0/R1 ratio (TC cancellation)
    "kr3":    (1.0, 0.85, 1.15),           # trim on R3 (sets vref)
    "It":     (0.2e-6, 0.08e-6, 0.5e-6),   # OTA tail current
    "gmid_in": (20.0, 12.0, 25.0),
    "L_in":   (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),
    "gmid_p": (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "L_p":    (8.0, 2.0, 15.0),
    "Cpb":    (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 8e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    MQ1 = 8
    Ie = p["Ie"]
    dV = UT * math.log(N)
    R1 = dV / Ie
    Veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log((Ie / MQ1) / 10e-6)
    dVeb_dT = -(1.27 - Veb) / 300.0
    R0 = p["r0k"] * R1
    I = Ie + Veb / R0
    R3 = p["kr3"] * 0.66 / I
    It = p["It"]
    Ib = 0.5 * It

    # devices
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I, vds=0.9)          # core/output mirror
    mpl = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], It / 2, vds=0.9)    # OTA load (same gm/Id, L)
    mpb = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Ib, vds=0.9)        # bias branch
    vtail = 0.2
    for _ in range(3):
        mi = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(0.08, Veb - mi.vgs)
    mb = lut.size("n", 14.0, 4.0, Ib, vds=0.4)                     # tail reference diode
    mt = lut.size("n", 14.0, 4.0, It, vds=vtail)                   # tail source

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # Banba core
    n.dev("M3", "va", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "va", m=MQ1)
    n.R("R0A", "va", "vss", R0)
    n.dev("M4", "vb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R1", "vb", "qb", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "qb", m=MQ1 * N)
    n.R("R0B", "vb", "vss", R0)
    # OTA: diode side gate = vb, output side gate = va, output = pb
    n.dev("M7", "od", "vb", "tl", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("M8", "pb", "va", "tl", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("M10", "od", "od", "vdd", "vdd", mpl)
    n.dev("M11", "pb", "od", "vdd", "vdd", mpl)
    n.dev("M9", "tl", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # self-bias for tail
    n.dev("M6", "nb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MB", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.C("CPB", "vdd", "pb", p["Cpb"])
    # output branch
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    # start-up: weak pull-up gated by vref; MS1 pulls pb low; MS3 (copy of MB) kills it once biased
    n.M("MSP1", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MSP2", "sg", "vref", "sx", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.dev("MS3", "sg", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.M("MS1", "pb", "sg", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)

    # predictions
    vref = R3 * I
    dI_dT = (dV / 300.0) / R1 + dVeb_dT / R0
    tc_ppm = abs(R3 * dI_dT) / vref * 1e6 + 150.0
    lam_p = mp.gds / I
    A_ota = mi.gm / (mi.gds + mpl.gds)
    line = vref * lam_p + vref * (lam_p / (mi.gm / (It / 2))) / max(A_ota, 1.0) / dV
    psrr = -db(max(line, 1e-6))
    power = VDD * (3 * I + It + Ib + 0.02e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc_ppm, "line_reg": line,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
